local_callback.title: Sign in with Tesla
local_callback.description: Open **[the Tesla sign-in page]({tesla_login_url})** in a new tab on a desktop computer. Before signing in, open Developer Tools (F12), select **Network**, and enable **Preserve log**. Sign in with Tesla. If the browser asks to open a Tesla app, cancel opening the app. Copy the complete tesla://auth/callback address from the console or the last redirect Location field and paste it here. Keep the address private.
